title: A Christmas to Remember – Addis Ababa, 1975
style_block: faded warm 1970s 35mm film photograph, nostalgic Addis Ababa atmosphere, gentle analog grain, warm golden highlights, natural shadows, no text or watermarks
character_sheet_prompt: 1970s vintage family reference sheet of an Ethiopian father as a young boy around 9 years old with short dark hair, curious bright eyes, warm playful smile, wearing a neat vintage 1970s sweater and trousers, alongside his parents in classic 1970s Ethiopian attire and a white Volkswagen sedan, warm faded 1970s film look.
music_prompt: Warm nostalgic 1970s Ethiopian instrumental score with gentle acoustic krar, soft piano, and subtle light percussion, affectionate and slightly playful holiday mood, no lyrics, quiet underscore under voice
closing_line_en: Some journeys end, but the memories travel through generations.

shots.purpose: Set the 1975 Ethiopian Christmas mood and show the family starting from Gotera in their white Volkswagen.
shots.narration_local: በ1975 ገና በዓል አካባቢ ነበር። አያቶቼ እና አምስት ልጆቻቸው—አራት ወንዶች እና አንዲት ሴት—ከጎተራ በነጭ ፎልክስዋገን ወደ ጃን ሜዳ ተነሱ።
shots.subtitles_en: It was Christmas, around 1975. My grandparents and their five children—four boys and one girl—set off from Gotera in their white Volkswagen for Jan Meda.
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot of a white 1970s Volkswagen sedan parked on a dusty sunlit road in Gotera, Addis Ababa in 1975, family getting ready for a festive morning drive, warm 1970s film aesthetic.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle camera push-in toward the white Volkswagen in warm morning light.

shots.purpose: Show the warmth of community as Muslim family friends join the journey.
shots.narration_local: በመንገድ ላይ የቤተሰብ ሙስሊም ወዳጆች ተቀላቀሉን፤ ጉዞውን የበለጠ ልዩ እና ደስ የሚል አደረጉት።
shots.subtitles_en: Along the way, a few Muslim family friends joined them, making the journey even more special.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of warm-hearted Ethiopian family members and Muslim family friends greeting each other beside the white Volkswagen in 1975 Addis Ababa, smiling and joyful.
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle subtle camera movement with warm natural daylight.

shots.purpose: Capture the childhood excitement of driving past 4 Kilo, 6 Kilo, and Parliament.
shots.narration_local: ለልጆቹ ጉዞው ራሱ ጀብድ ነበር። አራት ኪሎን፣ ስድስት ኪሎን እና ፓርላማን ስናልፍ የሚታየው ነገር ሁሉ አዲስ ነበር።
shots.subtitles_en: For the children, the journey itself was an adventure. Passing 4 Kilo, 6 Kilo, and Parliament, there was so much to see.
shots.image_prompt: 1970s street scene in Addis Ababa viewed from a car window looking toward 4 Kilo, 6 Kilo, and Parliament avenues, classic 1970s cars and trees, warm nostalgic film tone.
shots.motion_prompt: Smooth forward tracking motion as if looking out from a moving car window.

shots.purpose: Continue the city journey past Meskel Square and the UN Economic Commission for Africa.
shots.narration_local: መስቀል አደባባይን እና የተባበሩት መንግስታት የአፍሪካ ኢኮኖሚክ ኮሚሽንን ስናልፍ ልባችን በደስታ ተሞላ።
shots.subtitles_en: Passing Meskel Square and the UN Economic Commission for Africa, every corner felt full of wonder.
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot of 1975 Addis Ababa near Meskel Square and the distinctive modernist UN Economic Commission for Africa building under bright highland sky, faded 1970s film colors.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow pan across the 1970s cityscape and sunlit boulevard.

shots.purpose: Show the memorable treat of glass milk bottles and biscuits upon reaching Jan Meda.
shots.narration_local: ጃን ሜዳ ስንደርስ በብርጭቆ ጠርሙስ የቀረበ ወተት ከብስኩት ጋር ተቋደስን፤ ለልጅ ጊዜ ከዚህ በላይ ምን አለ?
shots.subtitles_en: When they finally arrived at Jan Meda, they enjoyed milk served in glass bottles with biscuits.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of glass milk bottles and crisp biscuits arranged on a rustic table during a 1975 holiday gathering in Addis Ababa, warm nostalgic sunlight.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle zoom-in on the glass milk bottles and biscuits.

shots.purpose: Bring out the energy, playfulness, and festive spirit of the traditional Gena game.
shots.narration_local: ትልቁ ደስታ ግን የገና ጨዋታን ማየት ነበር። ሳቅ፣ ጭብጨባ እና የገና መንፈስ ሜዳውን ሞልቶት ነበር።
shots.subtitles_en: But the real excitement was watching people play the traditional Ethiopian Gena game, filled with laughter and celebration.
shots.image_prompt: Wide festive shot of a lively 1975 traditional Ethiopian Gena game at Jan Meda with players and cheering spectators, playful energetic atmosphere, warm 1970s film look.
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle pan across the festive crowd and Gena players.

shots.purpose: Transition from the bustling game to heading home as afternoon settles.
shots.narration_local: ከደስታ የተሞላ ቀን በኋላ ወደ ቤት የምንመለስበት ሰዓት ደረሰ፤ ግን ጀብዱው ገና አላለቀም ነበር።
shots.subtitles_en: After a wonderful day, it was time to head home—but the adventure wasn't quite over.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of the young boy and siblings sitting inside the warm white 1970s Volkswagen in late afternoon light, happy and slightly tired from a full day.
shots.motion_prompt: Subtle warm light shift and gentle camera drift.

shots.purpose: Capture the playful surprise stop at a famous café for cake on the way back.
shots.narration_local: በመመለሻ መንገድ በታዋቂ ካፌ ቆም አልን፤ የመጨረሻው ጣፋጭ ስጦታ ጣፋጭ ኬክ ነበር።
shots.subtitles_en: On the way back, the family stopped at a famous café for one final treat: delicious cake.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of a slice of classic 1970s café cake on a small plate inside a cozy vintage Addis Ababa café, warm inviting lighting.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle push-in toward the cake in warm café light.

shots.purpose: Deliver the emotional heart of the story—family togetherness and a lasting memory.
shots.narration_local: እንዲህ ቀላል የመኪና ጉዞ፣ አንድ ላይ የሆነ ቤተሰብ እና ለትውልድ የሚተላለፍ የገና ትውስታ ተፈጠረ።
shots.subtitles_en: A simple car journey, a family together, and a Christmas that would be remembered for generations.
shots.image_prompt: Medium close-up of the father as a smiling young boy beside his parents in golden evening light, warm emotional expression, 1970s film aesthetic.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle push-in with soft golden light.

shots.purpose: Close with the poetic reflection that memories travel across generations.
shots.narration_local: አንዳንድ ጉዞዎች ያበቃሉ፤ ግን ትውስታዎች በትውልዶች መካከል ይጓዛሉ።
shots.subtitles_en: Some journeys end, but the memories travel through generations.
shots.image_prompt: Wide nostalgic shot of the white Volkswagen driving gently down a tree-lined Addis Ababa road at dusk with soft golden-amber light fading smoothly.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow pull-back and warm fade toward dusk.
